title: F-1 Live Information
native_title: Ｆ‐１ ライブインフォメーション
overview:
Bringing back the thrill of F-1 broadcasts! Your driving, with heated live commentary!!

Three men famous for their live F-1 broadcasts give full commentary on your driving, making the race even more exciting! The racing is authentic too. Your driving and strategy change depending on your settings. Keep track of your machine's condition as it changes moment by moment during the race, and time your pit stops!

F-1中継の感動を呼び起こす!
君の走りを白熱の実況で!!

F-1の実況中継で有名な3人が、君の走りを完全実況。レースをより一層盛り上げる!
レースも本格的。セッティング次第で走り/戦略が変わる。レース中、刻一刻と変わるマシン状況を把握し、ピットインのタイミングを計れ!
